verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a read-only Stats API that returns aggregated metrics as JSON, a manual 'Export stats: download your data' feature, and CSV import. None of these is a warehouse connector, an in-product way to query warehouse tables, or a continuous event export. A one-off download and an API a developer could poll are building blocks, not the warehouse sync capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync events between the platform and my own data warehouse (query warehouse tables in-product or export events continuously to it)
